title: Formula for the limiting majority Fourier weight
statement: For every natural number $k$, the limiting majority Fourier weight is $\frac{4}{\pi k 2^k}\binom{k-1}{(k-1)/2}$ when $k$ is odd, and is $0$ when $k$ is even.
